real_run_oom_REPRODUCED.outcome: OOM during d0X cold compile / first integration (real_run_oom.log)
real_run_oom_REPRODUCED.driver_level_event: cuda_executor.cc:1206 Failed to allocate 12.72 GiB (13,659,682,048 bytes) CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY -- MATCHES the reported ~13.7 GiB failing allocation
real_run_oom_REPRODUCED.bfc_level_event: GPU_0_bfc ran out of memory trying to allocate 2.09 GiB (rounded 2,242,678,016) repeatedly; BFC fragmentation map shows free holes too small for the 2.09 GiB block (***___***___***)
real_run_oom_REPRODUCED.interpretation: The working set drove device usage to ~31.8 GiB of 32 GiB; the 12.72 GiB request is XLA reserving a large CONTIGUOUS scratch arena (whole-program temp, cf. the LW allocation-199 preallocated-temp arena pattern) that does not fit alongside the already-resident multi-domain state + other-process 2.9 GiB baseline. The recurring 2.09 GiB BFC requests are the per-step radiation/PBL transients that cannot find a contiguous block once fragmented. This is a WORKING-SET-too-large + FRAGMENTATION failure, NOT a single fundamental 12.72 GiB buffer.
real_run_oom_REPRODUCED.note_baseline: ~2.9 GiB was held by OTHER processes (not this run) for the whole experiment, eating into the 32 GiB budget.

No src/ edit.

tile_sweep_d03.note: peak_gib and transient_gib are device high-water marks; transient = peak - base(resident inputs). All fp64.

mynn.interpretation: DOMINATED by an O(ncol) FLOOR that tiling does NOT remove (full padded scan carry+output state across ~30 leaves)

tiling_verdict: TILING WORKS. LW and SW per-call transients drop near-linearly with tile_cols (LW 5.06->1.23 GiB at 16384->2048). MYNN drops only weakly (3.32->2.45) because its dominant cost is a tiling-IMMUNE full-column padded scan carry+output state, NOT the dense (tile,nz,nz) BouLac term.

dominant_buffers_mynn.floor_source: _tiled_mynn_step (src/gpuwrf/physics/mynn_pbl.py:1810-1844): pads ALL ~25-30 state leaves to (padded_ncol, nz) for BOTH the input padded_state AND init_state (tree_map zeros_like), and lax.scan scatters per-tile outputs into the full padded carry. ~30 leaves x 147456 x 45 x 8 B ~= 1.5 GiB x2 (in+out) ~= 2.4 GiB = the measured tiling-immune floor.

failing_alloc_13_7gib_explanation: REPRODUCED: the real run fails on a driver-level 12.72 GiB (13.66 GB) contiguous allocation = XLA reserving a whole-program preallocated-temp scratch arena (the same arena class as LW allocation-199, but for a much larger nested/d03 program), PLUS recurring BFC 2.09 GiB per-step transient requests that cannot find a contiguous hole. smi peaked at 31.8 GiB of 32 GiB (minus ~2.9 GiB held by other processes => effectively ~29 GiB available). It is NOT one fundamental 12.72 GiB buffer: it is (resident multi-domain state) + (a 5-GiB-class d03 LW transient) + (d03 dynamics/acoustic scratch) + (XLA arena padding) all summing to ~30 GiB, at which point the next large contiguous arena request (12.72 GiB) or per-step block (2.09 GiB) cannot be satisfied. The shipped mitigation (platform/cudaMalloc allocator + per-output-hour segmentation in nested_pipeline.py) reduces FRAGMENTATION but does not reduce the underlying ~5-GiB-class transient working set -- which finer tiling does.
limitation: A buffer-assignment for the FULL nested program could not be captured because the nested run OOMs during compile/first-exec. The dominant-buffer naming is therefore from the standalone d03-scale LW/SW/MYNN programs (faithful: the coupler feeds the solvers flattened (ncol,nz) views, no extra full-ncol arrays). The real-run 12.72 GiB contiguous arena is consistent with the standalone LW preallocated-temp arena (allocation 199, 4.89 GiB at tile=16384) scaled up by the larger nested program + dynamics scratch; exact per-op attribution of the nested 12.72 GiB request would need an HLO dump from a config that compiles without OOM (e.g. tile=2048).

achievable_peak_estimate.lever_1_finer_lw_sw_tile: Set GPUWRF_RRTMG_LW/SW_COLUMN_TILE_COLS=2048: LW transient 5.06->1.23 GiB, SW 1.67->0.82 GiB. Bit-identical (proofs/v013 rrtmg_column_tile inertness). Pure env knob, no code change.
achievable_peak_estimate.lever_2_mynn_floor: MYNN floor 2.42 GiB is NOT a tile knob; needs buffer-donation / in-place scatter so the padded input and output carry alias (would roughly halve to ~1.5 GiB). Code change (out of measurement scope).
achievable_peak_estimate.lever_3_cldfmc_taucmc_chunk: The 2.81 GiB LW cldfmc+taucmc pair is the single biggest LW item and is NOT band-chunked (built up front, held across the band scan). Building per-band inside the existing band lax.scan (like _lw_taumol_band already is) would cut it to one band's (tile,nlay,16) ~= 0.18 GiB. Code change.
achievable_peak_estimate.lever_4_dynamics_segmentation: Already shipped (platform allocator + per-output-hour segmentation) to bound fragmentation.
achievable_peak_estimate.realistic_d03_peak_with_env_only_tile204: resident(~2.5) + max(LW 1.23) + dyn(0.7) ~= 4.5 GiB working set; comfortably < 32 GiB and not fragmentation-prone.
achievable_peak_estimate.realistic_d03_peak_with_code_changes_gib: resident(~2.5) + LW-per-band-cldfmc(~0.5) + MYNN-donated(~1.5) ~= 3-4 GiB; approaches but does not beat CPU-WRF ~10 GiB total RSS only because the GPU resident set + per-tile transients are already smaller than CPU's 12-rank halo+tile working set.

localized_dominant_buffer: RRTMG-LW McICA cloud-optics pair cldfmc + taucmc, each f64[tile, nlay, 16 bands, 16 g-points] (1.41 GiB at tile=16384, 2.81 GiB for the pair), built in _lw_cldprmc_state (src/gpuwrf/physics/rrtmg_lw.py:1920-1946) and held live across the whole 16-band flux scan. Secondary: the McICA random mask f64[6300,tile] (0.77 GiB). MYNN secondary floor: full-column padded scan carry+output state (~2.4 GiB, tiling-immune).
